rationale: The entire day's range is ~6 bps ($50.11–$50.14) against a 2 bps spread, with 5-minute ATR of ~1.1 bps and price, VWAP, and the 9-EMA all pinned at the same level — the expected move per holding period is smaller than the round-trip cost.
